pages.text: {{hero}} and Dad sit on the sand. The sun is hot. {{hero}} can swim and splash. Splish, splash! {{hero}} has a pink net.
{{hero}} spots a big shell in the sand. It is pink with a black spot. {{hero}} wants to get the shell for Mom.
But the shell is stuck in a crack in a rock. {{hero}} tugs and tugs, but it will not lift.
Dad has a plan. Dad and {{hero}} dig in the sand. Dig, dig, dig! The shell pops up. {{hero}} grins.
At dusk, {{hero}} is in bed with the shell. {{hero}} hugs Mom. But then the shell went tick, tick, tick! What is in the shell?
